$comment: The landing showcase's half of the cross-repository contract, data only.
The laws are not here. They are the failure messages of the gates in @nanisoft/prism-ui/gates
which this repository pins exactly. What is here is what only this site knows:
which sheet is its own, where its export is hosted, how much of it counts as
having read something, what its pack map describes, and which source roots read
no tokens at runtime. This site has no own sheet, so the stylesheet-ownership and
hidden-state floors are 0. It names the view-only gate because it is the shape
that law holds: no stylesheet, no style tooling, no client module, no inline
